sup:70610.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

It is always a pleasure to work with you, and we are delighted to present our proposal for your component requirements. As a reliable supply partner, we pride ourselves on delivering excellent service and maintaining a comprehensive product range to keep your production running smoothly. 

For the requested volume, we can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit. This quote comes with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We trust this proposal meets your expectations and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship. Please do not hesitate to reach out if you have any questions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.subject: Re: One supplier for the kit – offer:70610-0
move.body:
Dear Mr Stadler,

Thank you for offer:70610-0 and for your continued support. You already supply part:360012 at a 30% quota, so this builds on a proven relationship.

Could you share a cost breakdown per kit, your best price at the full 30,000-unit volume, and your earliest lead time?

To reward a longer commitment, we propose:
(1) EUR 5.45 per kit, 45 days net, 36-month term.
(2) EUR 5.55 per kit, 30 days net, 24-month term.

Our master contract ctr:4600070610 runs at 90 days net, so 45 days is a fair middle. Given your 2026Q3 on-time figure of 88.6% (sc:70610@2026Q3), a service commitment would help.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,
Many thanks for your e-mail, and great to hear from you; I went through it right away with our team.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.58 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months.
A few words on this from our side.
The rival quote data you cite does not concern this part or our company.
We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
Thank you for your constructive proposal and the opportunity to build on our proven relationship with a 24-month commitment.
As a distributor, we do not share internal cost breakdowns, but our team will gladly clarify lead times for the full volume to ensure your production runs smoothly.
Taking into account the extended contract term and your feedback on delivery, we can offer a revised price of €5.58 per kit at 30 days net.
Material accounts for about 61 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
Which volume can you commit to?
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

Dear customer,
Many thanks for your e-mail, and great to hear from you; I went through it right away with our team.
This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.
Our terms: a price of €5.58 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months.
Here is the background.
We appreciate your prompt feedback, but we are unable to reduce the price further without a change in the underlying conditions.
As mentioned previously, a binding commitment to a higher volume would allow us to review our pricing structure.
Therefore, our offer remains at EUR 5.58 per kit for a 24-month contract with 30 days net payment terms.
Which volume can you commit to?
Our conditions follow our Preisliste and discount tiers.
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
